_note: Arrow wounds on spiders, chaurus, scribs and ash hoppers: shafts punched through chitin, pale ichor. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the point cracking through the chitin with a dry snap. The shaft sticks fast and {name} hisses and recoils, legs scrabbling.
, the arrowhead punching into chitin that is already cracked. The split widens around the shaft and pale ichor seeps out; {name} shrieks and thrashes. The air turns bitter with the smell of ichor.
, and the arrow drives deep into the broken shell. Ichor spurts around the shaft in thick gouts and {name} shrieks and convulses, legs clawing at nothing. An acrid stench fills the air.
, and it is too much. The shell gives way around the arrows; {name} folds up, legs curling and twitching, ichor pooling beneath {name}.
